configModel.classMethods: Config has only a constructor (model.ts:539-744); no unused class-method subtree. One physical model module and one emitted Config class were found.
configModel.security: normalizeConfig constructs the canonical complete schema and knownFields from Object.keys(new Config()), rejects unknown sensitive keys, migrates defaults/model identities and preserves legitimate fields. Dropping unsupported UI fields changes backup/config/history compatibility and the known-fields security boundary; not an authorized size optimization.

configStore.aggregationProblem: The dynamic bootstrap namespace, not a duplicate Config schema or store class, is the identified retention root. Store is implemented by functions.
configStore.credentialContext: userscript/credentialContext.ts returns true because storage is GM-private.
configStore.writeOwner: userscript/storage.ts sets writeOwner:true, and configStorage spreads this value while enforcing preparation readiness. Rollup does not visibly fold every configStorage.writeOwner branch through that aggregate.
configStore.notSafeToDelete: Both ordinary UI and platform still use shared mutation/history/count/credential authority. Do not remove code based solely on extension-origin labels or rewrite GM ownership/security paths for speculative savings.
